description: This walk takes you from the North Yorkshire village of Lealholm to the neighbouring villages of Glaisdale, Egton Bridge and Grosmont. The route follows a section of the Esk Valley Walk along the River Esk with fine views of the surrounding North York Moors countryside. On the walk you will also pass some fine old bridges with lots of wildlife to see as well.
